_comment: Which repos count a green CI job as the OS proof for a MERGE, read by scripts/shared-memory-post.py
(it refuses a single-PR OS hand-check request there) and by helpers/merge-request-gate.cjs.
Copy to .claude/rules/os-proof.json in the brain. Map: "<owner/repo>": [<OS>, ...] - the systems whose
green CI job stands in for a hand check. A hand check then happens at most once per OS at a merge
train's head. Leave a repo out when its behaviour needs a device, a desk or live hardware: there the
hand check per PR stays. An empty map means every OS check is by hand.
